title: VPC Connectivity & Network Costs
summary: Connecting VPCs to each other, to AWS services and to on-premises networks: VPC peering, gateway and interface (PrivateLink) endpoints, Flow Logs, Site-to-Site VPN and CloudHub, Direct Connect and Direct Connect gateway, Transit Gateway with ECMP, Traffic Mirroring, IPv6 and the egress-only internet gateway, data transfer costs, and AWS Network Firewall.
